lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: i pointed at the board and ordered, just like everyone else. liam, you can stop worrying about the fries now :)

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: the spreadsheet line survived with change to spare. cyrus, your list is undefeated

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: loaded burger, zero cheese, quiet stomach. best market night yet!!

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: Everyone, stop. Peanut sauce on every patty. This is the stall from my notes.

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: abort abort!! burgers DOWN, nobody hand cyrus anything

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i was one bite away. worth it. cyrus, lead us somewhere safe

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: oh... there's meat in every burger here. it's okay, i can just get some fries

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: NO. not the plate of fries. not on redemption night. everybody up

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: liam's right. we are not doing fries, round two

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: THREE dollar signs for a burger?? wallets away, all of you. we're leaving. this is a trip fund emergency

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: she's confiscating our wallets. i'm scared and i respect it

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: For the record, the notes said cheap. Following Maya.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: great burger. two dollar signs though, so i'm sulking the whole bus ride home. as promised

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i'll sit next to you on the bus. sulking's better with company

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: i just ordered the classic, the way it comes. milk bun toasted in butter, melted cheese, garlic butter fries. milkshake incident: the sequel. my stomach is NOT happy

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: our old campus burger spot!! roxy, i'm so sorry. there was a lettuce-wrap one with none of that. next time i'm ordering for you
